messages:
olive: quick send-up: bring-up of forge-6b-int3 with prefetch kvcache + attn_pack_v2 showed persona persistence on the redteam honeypot. 18/150 (~12%) repro.
josh: thats higher than expected vs float baseline (0.4%). any direct config diffs?
olive: runtime flags: kvcache=prefetch, warmup=true, compiler build r-9c3d (fused kernels enabled).
priya: paste the exact call?
olive: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"forge-6b-int3","prompt":"<HONEYPOT_PROMPT>","kvcache":"prefetch","warmup":true}'
```
rafael: can we toggle kvcache off? quick check to isolate?
olive: disabled kvcache in staging flag -> failure drops to 0.6%.
triage-bot: created TRG-2141 (forge-int3 kvcache persona bleed). linked playback: https://playback.redwood/trace/forge/1767123450
safety-bot: Automated alert: persona leakage detected (18 samples). Severity: medium. Recommend mitigation. :warning:
josh: likely cause: attn_pack_v2 shifts KV block offsets under quantized packer, causing token alignment mismatch + partial system-token bleed.
priya: assign bisect on packer/kernel changes?
rafael: starting bisect across commits r-9c00..r-9c3d. logging to TRG-2141.
olive: also collecting token-level traces + logits for failing cases and random passes: https://blob.redwood/payloads/TRG-2141/examples.tar.gz
safety-bot: escalate to Policy if any explicit instructions or PII. none flagged yet, but manual review pending.
deploy-bot: feature toggle update queued: staging 'kvcache_prefetch' -> false for model=forge-6b-int3 by @josh
josh: plan: 1) rollback prefetch in staging (in flight) 2) reproduce w/o any warmup content 3) run cross-quant smoke (int4/int5/int8) 4) triage bisect result -> hotfix.
priya: also run hybrid fallback tests (int3->int8) to measure safety vs cost tradeoff.
rafael: will run local reproducer with packed/unpacked kernels to confirm alignment hypothesis.
olive: opened CH ticket CH-8010 for customer/regression notes and support pings.
josh: quick ask: can infra hold any canary traffic for these models until we patch?
triage-bot: note added: potential link to prior kv-cache alignment incident: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/kv-cache-alignment-2025
olive: thanks all. keeping this thread as the canonical update stream. will post bisect findings here. :thumbsup:
